research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Waymo is researching self driving technologies that combine vehicle perception, mapping, and rider experience. Filings such as Early boarding of passengers in autonomous vehicles, Queueing into Pickup and Drop-off Locations, and Arranging passenger pickups for autonomous vehicles describe optimizing pickup logistics. Titles including Thermal imaging for self-driving cars, Onboard cluster tracking system, and Multimode lidar receiver for coherent distance and velocity measurements show work on sensing and environment understanding for safe autonomous driving and trip services.

overview_description.description: Waymo develops autonomous driving systems and operates driverless vehicle services. The company designs software and integrates sensors such as lidar, radar, and cameras to enable vehicle automation. It collaborates with automotive manufacturers to incorporate its technology into electric vehicles. Waymo also explores the use of autonomous systems in ride-hailing and freight transport.
